faq.question: What types of scholarships are available for engineering students in Maine?
faq.answer: There are currently five scholarships listed for engineering students in Maine, covering various categories including STEM and education. The award sizes range from approximately $500 to $2,500, providing a range of financial support options.

faq.answer: Most of the scholarships listed do not require an essay, though it's advisable to verify the details for each specific listing. Many of the scholarships have lighter application requirements, making them more accessible.
